title: Page sections

fields.label: Page sections
fields.name: page_sections
fields.instructions: The page's bands, in order. The page head is above and is always present.

sub_fields.label: Anchor id
sub_fields.name: band_id
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, for in-page links, e.g. inquiry.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: band_heading
sub_fields.instructions: <br> and <em> are allowed.

sub_fields.label: Rows
sub_fields.name: band_rows
sub_fields.instructions: The band's content rows, in order. A band may have none.

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: placeholder_note
sub_fields.instructions: Text shown in the placeholder marker. Leave empty for the default wording.

sub_fields.label: Media column
sub_fields.name: text_media_media_kind
sub_fields.instructions: What sits beside the text. Tables uses this row's own Tables repeater. Leave empty for a full-width text row. Figure, Diagram and Video are set up at the foot of this row.

sub_fields.label: Flip
sub_fields.name: text_media_flip
sub_fields.instructions: Put the media column on the left.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: text_media_heading
sub_fields.instructions: <br> and <em> are allowed.

sub_fields.label: Body
sub_fields.name: text_media_body
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs, bold, italic and links.

sub_fields.label: Callout
sub_fields.name: text_media_callout
sub_fields.instructions: Optional emphasised line below the body.

sub_fields.label: Labelled passages
sub_fields.name: text_media_group
sub_fields.instructions: Short labelled passages, shown after the body.

sub_fields.label: Tables
sub_fields.name: text_media_table
sub_fields.instructions: Specification tables, shown after the labelled passages â€” or beside the text, when Media column is set to Tables.

sub_fields.label: Closing text
sub_fields.name: text_media_closing
sub_fields.instructions: Optional paragraph after the callout.

sub_fields.label: Links
sub_fields.name: text_media_link
sub_fields.instructions: Related links, shown after the closing text.

sub_fields.label: Diagram
sub_fields.name: text_media_diagram
sub_fields.instructions: Diagrams ship with the theme; the choices come from verquin_diagrams().

sub_fields.label: Video
sub_fields.name: text_media_video
sub_fields.instructions: YouTube only. With no URL, a labelled placeholder is shown instead, so the row can be composed before the video exists.

sub_fields.label: YouTube URL
sub_fields.name: text_media_video_url
sub_fields.instructions: Watch, share, embed or shorts link.

sub_fields.label: Ratio
sub_fields.name: text_media_video_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for the default 16:9.

sub_fields.label: Slot code
sub_fields.name: text_media_video_slot
sub_fields.instructions: From the photo-slot sheet, e.g. SVC-07. Used by the placeholder until the video is supplied.

sub_fields.label: Placeholder description
sub_fields.name: text_media_video_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: Shown in the placeholder while the video is missing.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: text_media_video_caption
sub_fields.instructions: Also supplies the embed's accessible name.

sub_fields.label: Figure
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure
sub_fields.instructions: With a slot code but no image, a labelled placeholder is shown.

sub_fields.label: Slot code
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure_slot
sub_fields.instructions: From the photo-slot sheet, e.g. HOM-01.

sub_fields.label: Asset type
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure_kind
sub_fields.instructions: Labels the placeholder box only; it does not change what the column renders. For a real video, set Media column to Video.

sub_fields.label: Ratio
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to keep the image's own proportions.

sub_fields.label: Fit
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure_fit
sub_fields.instructions: How the image meets its frame. Cover crops it to fill the frame. Contain fits the whole image inside it, which keeps titles and edges readable on document thumbnails.

sub_fields.label: Image description
sub_fields.name: text_media_figure_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: What the image shows, in a few words. Used as the image's alt text, and shown in the placeholder until the image arrives. Alt text set on the image in the Media Library wins over this.

sub_fields.label: Side by side
sub_fields.name: spec_tables_paired
sub_fields.instructions: Two columns from tablet width. Off, tables stack.

sub_fields.label: Narrow
sub_fields.name: spec_tables_narrow
sub_fields.instructions: Cap the row at reading width.

sub_fields.label: Tables
sub_fields.name: spec_tables_table
sub_fields.instructions: One to four tables.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: spec_tables_table_caption
sub_fields.instructions: Shown above the table.

sub_fields.label: Index
sub_fields.name: cards_card_index
sub_fields.instructions: Small label above the title, e.g. 01.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: cards_card_title
sub_fields.instructions: Required. A card without a title is not rendered.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: cards_card_text
sub_fields.instructions: Plain text, no markup.

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: cards_card_note
sub_fields.instructions: Footnote, e.g. Patent protected.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: cards_card_link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Makes the whole card a link. Leave empty if the card uses Download links below.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: cards_card_figure
sub_fields.instructions: Optional tile image above the title.

sub_fields.label: Slot
sub_fields.name: cards_card_figure_slot
sub_fields.instructions: Handoff slot code, e.g. NEMA-01.

sub_fields.label: Fit
sub_fields.name: cards_card_figure_fit
sub_fields.instructions: How the image meets its frame. Cover crops it to fill the frame. Contain fits the whole image inside it, which keeps titles and edges readable on document thumbnails.

sub_fields.label: Image description
sub_fields.name: cards_card_figure_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: What the image shows, in a few words. Used as the image's alt text, and shown in the placeholder until the image arrives. Alt text set on the image in the Media Library wins over this.

sub_fields.label: Download links
sub_fields.name: cards_card_links
sub_fields.instructions: Links listed inside the card, e.g. Download PDF. A card with these must leave Link empty.

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: cards_card_links_link
sub_fields.instructions: Search for a page or media item, or paste a URL. The link text becomes the label.

sub_fields.label: Pages
sub_fields.name: child_index_mode
sub_fields.instructions: Automatic lists this page's published children in menu order.

sub_fields.label: Chosen pages
sub_fields.name: child_index_pages
sub_fields.instructions: In the order they should appear.

sub_fields.label: Figures
sub_fields.name: gallery_figure
sub_fields.instructions: Two or more figures in an auto-fitting grid.

sub_fields.label: Slot code
sub_fields.name: gallery_figure_slot
sub_fields.instructions: From the photo-slot sheet, e.g. STA-02.

sub_fields.label: Ratio
sub_fields.name: gallery_figure_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for the default 16:10.

sub_fields.label: Fit
sub_fields.name: gallery_figure_fit
sub_fields.instructions: How the image meets its frame. Cover crops it to fill the frame. Contain fits the whole image inside it, which keeps titles and edges readable on document thumbnails.

sub_fields.label: Image description
sub_fields.name: gallery_figure_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: What the image shows, in a few words. Used as the image's alt text, and shown in the placeholder until the image arrives. Alt text set on the image in the Media Library wins over this.

sub_fields.label: Narrow
sub_fields.name: figure_narrow
sub_fields.instructions: Cap the figure at reading width.

sub_fields.label: Figure
sub_fields.name: figure_figure
sub_fields.instructions: With a slot code but no image, a labelled placeholder is shown.

sub_fields.label: Slot code
sub_fields.name: figure_figure_slot
sub_fields.instructions: From the photo-slot sheet, e.g. GEO-02.

sub_fields.label: Asset type
sub_fields.name: figure_figure_kind
sub_fields.instructions: Logo renders the framework's white logo card.

sub_fields.label: Ratio
sub_fields.name: figure_figure_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for the default 16:10. Ignored for a logo card.

sub_fields.label: Fit
sub_fields.name: figure_figure_fit
sub_fields.instructions: How the image meets its frame. Cover crops it to fill the frame. Contain fits the whole image inside it, which keeps titles and edges readable on document thumbnails.

sub_fields.label: Image description
sub_fields.name: figure_figure_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: What the image shows, in a few words. Used as the image's alt text, and shown in the placeholder until the image arrives. Alt text set on the image in the Media Library wins over this.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: callout_html
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs, bold, italic and links.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text_html
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs, bold, italic and links.

sub_fields.label: Note
sub_fields.name: pending_note
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for "Copy to be supplied."

sub_fields.label: Events
sub_fields.name: timeline_event
sub_fields.instructions: In the order they should appear.

sub_fields.label: Year
sub_fields.name: timeline_event_year
sub_fields.instructions: Required. Shown on the marker, e.g. 1988.

sub_fields.label: Body
sub_fields.name: timeline_event_body
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs, bold, italic and links.

sub_fields.label: Groups
sub_fields.name: references_group
sub_fields.instructions: One numbered list per subject heading.

sub_fields.label: Questions
sub_fields.name: faq_item
sub_fields.instructions: One group of questions. The framework splits its ten across four bands.

sub_fields.label: Question
sub_fields.name: faq_item_question
sub_fields.instructions: Required.

sub_fields.label: Verdict
sub_fields.name: faq_item_verdict
sub_fields.instructions: Short lead answer, e.g. Yes. / No. / Usually.

sub_fields.label: Answer
sub_fields.name: faq_item_answer
sub_fields.instructions: Paragraphs, bold, italic and links.

sub_fields.label: Table
sub_fields.name: faq_item_table
sub_fields.instructions: Optional specification table, shown after the answer.

sub_fields.label: Callout
sub_fields.name: faq_item_callout
sub_fields.instructions: Optional emphasised note, shown after the table.

sub_fields.label: Closing text
sub_fields.name: faq_item_closing
sub_fields.instructions: Optional paragraph after the callout.

sub_fields.label: Links
sub_fields.name: faq_item_link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional related links, shown last.

sub_fields.label: Diagram
sub_fields.name: diagram_diagram
sub_fields.instructions: Diagrams ship with the theme. The choices come from verquin_diagrams() in inc/blocks/diagram.php; this stored list is a fallback only.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: diagram_caption
sub_fields.instructions: The diagram carries its own accessible description; this is the visible caption.

sub_fields.label: YouTube URL
sub_fields.name: video_url
sub_fields.instructions: Watch, share, embed or shorts link. Leave empty to show a labelled placeholder.

sub_fields.label: Ratio
sub_fields.name: video_ratio
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty for the default 16:9.

sub_fields.label: Slot code
sub_fields.name: video_slot
sub_fields.instructions: From the photo-slot sheet, e.g. DDBM-03. Used by the placeholder until the video is supplied.

sub_fields.label: Placeholder description
sub_fields.name: video_placeholder
sub_fields.instructions: Shown in the placeholder while the video is missing.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: video_caption
sub_fields.instructions: Also supplies the embed's accessible name.

sub_fields.label: Station
sub_fields.name: data_chart_station
sub_fields.instructions: The choices come from verquin_charts() in inc/charts.php; this stored list is a fallback only. Data is read from uploads/data/<station>/.

sub_fields.label: Chart
sub_fields.name: data_chart_kind
sub_fields.instructions: Not every station has both. A combination with no data renders nothing.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: data_chart_title
sub_fields.instructions: Shown above the chart. Empty uses the station's registered name.

sub_fields.label: Error bars
sub_fields.name: data_chart_error_bars
sub_fields.instructions: Position charts only.

sub_fields.label: Explanation
sub_fields.name: data_chart_footer
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under the chart, as on the legacy pages.

sub_fields.label: Anchor id
sub_fields.name: form_anchor
sub_fields.instructions: Optional, for in-page links, e.g. inquiry.

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: form_heading
sub_fields.instructions: <br> and <em> are allowed.

sub_fields.label: Form
sub_fields.name: form_id
sub_fields.instructions: The forms defined in Contact Form 7. The list is read live; nothing is stored in the field definition.

sub_fields.label: Wide
sub_fields.name: form_wide
sub_fields.instructions: Widen the column for long questionnaires.

description: Flexible Content composition for pages. Row layouts are added by their roadmap steps.
